plugins.name: laterbox
plugins.description: Parking lot for follow-up notes: /later parks a note at once, even mid-turn, after a model has cleaned its text, and alone opens a pane to work through the notes; a terminal command, later, reaches the same queue; a skill lists, closes and drops notes; a session-start line shows the count.
